name: fly-vscode-extension
description: Fly programming language support for Visual Studio Code: syntax highlighting, language server, formatting, build/run/debug and project commands for .fly files.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Fly
walkthroughs.description: Set up the Fly compiler, write your first program, and build and debug it.

steps.title: Select the Fly compiler
steps.description:
Run **Fly: Select Compiler** to point the extension to your Fly installation. The status bar shows the active version once found.

[Select Compiler](command:fly.selectCompiler)

steps.title: Write your first Fly program
steps.description: Create a `.fly` file and start typing — hover docs, completions, and syntax highlighting activate automatically.

steps.title: Build and run
steps.description: Press **Ctrl+F5** to compile and run, **Ctrl+Shift+B** to build only, or **F5** to launch the debugger (uses the lldb-dap bundled with the Fly toolchain). **Format Document** runs `fly fmt`.

steps.title: Manage your project
steps.description: Run **Fly: Init Project** to scaffold a `Manifest.fly`, then use **Fly: Build Project**, **Fly: Run Project** and **Fly: Add Dependency**.

commands.title: Fly: Init Project
commands.description: Scaffold Manifest.fly and src/main.fly in the workspace root

commands.title: Fly: Build Project
commands.description: Build the project (incremental — only recompiles changed targets)

commands.title: Fly: Add Dependency
commands.description: Add a git dependency to Manifest.fly and re-lock

commands.title: Fly: Remove Dependency
commands.description: Drop a dependency from Manifest.fly and re-lock

commands.title: Fly: Why Is This Dependency Here?
commands.description: Explain why a package is in the dependency graph

commands.title: Fly: Clean Project
commands.description: Remove the profile's output directory and its incremental fingerprints

program.description: Path to the executable to debug.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the program.

configurationSnippets.label: Fly: Launch and debug current file
configurationSnippets.description: Launch an executable built with --debug-symbols under the lldb-dap bundled with the Fly toolchain.

task.description: The fly task to run (e.g. build)

fly.compilerPath.description: Path to the Fly compiler executable (fly). The language server and the debugger are looked up next to it.

fly.enableDiagnostics.description: Run the Fly compiler on save and show errors and warnings as inline diagnostics. Fallback only: ignored while fly.enableLsp is on — the language server is then the single source of diagnostics.

fly.lspPath.description: Path to the fly-lsp binary. Leave empty to auto-discover next to fly.compilerPath.

fly.enableLsp.description: Enable the Fly Language Server for semantic features (diagnostics, hover on symbols, go-to-definition, find references, outline). Changing it needs a window reload.

fly.buildArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the fly compiler when running 'Fly: Build File', e.g. "-O2" or "-o bin/myapp". Separated by spaces; double quotes group an argument that contains one.

fly.runArgs.description: Arguments passed to the program started by 'Fly: Run File' and 'Fly: Debug File'. Separated by spaces; double quotes group an argument that contains one.

fly.projectProfile.description: Build profile used by the Fly: Build / Run / Test / Clean Project commands. Empty = debug (-O0, debug info); "release" = --release (-O3, no debug info); any other name is a profile declared in the manifest's 'profiles' field, passed as --profile <name>. 'Fly: Select Profile' lists them.

fly.projectForceRebuild.description: Pass --force to Fly: Build Project, bypassing the per-target fingerprint cache so every target is recompiled.

fly.projectBuildArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to 'fly build', e.g. "--target mybin" or "--out-dir dist". Use fly.projectProfile to select the profile.

fly.debugBuildArgs.description: Compiler flags used by 'Fly: Debug File'. --debug-symbols emits the debug information (source lines, parameters, local variables); --debug adds verbose compiler logging to it.

fly.enableWorkspaceDiagnostics.description: Scan all .fly files in the workspace for errors at startup, not only files that are explicitly opened. Fallback only: ignored while fly.enableLsp is on.
